job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
Senior Project Manager — Commercial Fit-Out & Construction
Bondi Junction, Sydney
The Opportunity
Step into a senior role with a Sydney fit?out and construction business carrying a 9.5–10/10 client reputation, a genuinely diverse project portfolio, and a founder-led leadership team that wants your voice at the table as it shapes the next 2–3 years of growth.
About the Business
This Bondi Junction–based commercial fit?out and construction company is known for collaborative problem?solving, zero?corners?cut delivery, and long-term relationships with government agencies, corporate landlords, FMCG operators and education clients. Repeat work is the norm — clients consistently cite trust, transparency and capability as the reasons they return.
Why This Role Is Different
  • A sophisticated client base — You’ll work with blue?chip and government clients across live facilities, corporate asset portfolios and operational FMCG environments. This isn’t a conveyor belt of low?complexity jobs.
  • Genuine project variety — Expect concurrent programs in the $1M–$7M+ range across multiple sectors, not the same project type on repeat.
  • Real decision-making authority — A defined, written decision?rights framework gives you ownership of your portfolio without chasing sign-off for routine calls.
  • Leadership that’s resourced, not incidental — Mentoring CAs and Site Managers is a core part of the role, supported by structure rather than squeezed around delivery.
  • A seat at the table — You’ll contribute directly to Vision & Goals planning and 90?day priority cycles with the founders, influencing how the business evolves.
  • Process ownership with visible impact — Lead improvements in procurement and handover consistency — an area the team and clients independently identify as the biggest opportunity.
  • Succession?relevant runway — With one co?founder planning a transition from day?to?day operations over the next 2–3 years, this role sits within the leadership pipeline supporting that shift (without being pitched as a direct replacement).
What You’ll Bring
  • Proven capability running multiple concurrent commercial fit?out/construction projects with limited senior oversight
  • A genuine track record of mentoring and developing CAs/PMs
  • Hands?on ownership of procurement and subcontractor engagement end?to?end
  • Comfort working with, and improving, remote/offshore support structures
  • Experience in owner?operator environments preferred — someone who thrives in fast?paced, direct communication settings
Practical Details
  • Reporting line: Direct to the founders
  • Project band: Complex refurbishment and fit?out projects $2M–$7M from day one
  • Salary: Negotiable
  • Start: September

job.title: WHS Manager
job.description:
WHSE Manager – Leading Builder

Join a prestigious Australian builder as a WHSE Manager, where exceptional staff retention highlights the company’s dedication to its people.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  • Oversee safety on large-scale data centre projects, up to $1 Billion
  • Manage site safety and subcontractors across multiple locations
  • Lead a team of 5 safety professionals and handle 3 project sites

About the Builder:
 
  • A top name in the Australian construction and development industry
  • Over 100 years of proven excellence in delivering innovative and high-quality projects
  • Renowned for meticulous planning, design control, and modern construction practices
  • Award-winning with exceptional staff retention and personalized career training

Role Overview:

As WHSE Manager, you will be primarily based at a data centre project in Western Sydney, while also overseeing two additional data centre sites with combined value over $1 Billion Your role includes mentoring safety professionals, planning, and conducting risk assessments throughout the project lifecycle. You will collaborate with project managers, site managers, contract administrators, and subcontractors, and report directly to the Group WHSE Manager.

Desired Skills and Qualifications:
 
  • At least 10 years of experience in an HSE role within a medium to large construction company
  • Proven background with major projects ($100M+) or similar HSE roles
  • Familiarity with Hammertech or similar safety software
  • Strong administrative, documentation, and communication skills
  • Highly organized with attention to detail and a team-oriented approach
  • Cert IV in Occupational Health and Safety required, additional qualifications preferred
  • A genuine passion for WHSE and the construction industry, committed to long-term growth in WHSE

What We Offer:
 
  • An organization that values communication, rewards achievements, and fosters strong team development
  • Comprehensive support and resources for you and your projects
  • Exceptional training and development opportunities
  • A competitive financial package commensurate with the role

If you are dedicated to WHSE and looking to make a significant impact, this opportunity is for you.

job.title: Building Services Coordinator
job.description:
Building Services Engineer – Major Data Centre Project

Join a leading commercial builder delivering a $100M+ mission critical data centre in Sydney. This is a career defining opportunity for a Building Services Engineer who wants exposure to complex services integration, modern construction techniques and a sector that’s rapidly expanding across Australia.

The Opportunity

Working closely with the Building Services Manager, you’ll support the full lifecycle of a major data centre build — from design reviews through to commissioning and handover. You’ll coordinate key building services packages and ensure seamless integration across mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and fire systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate MEP/HVAC, electrical, hydraulic and fire services

  • Manage documentation, compliance, RFIs and installation sequencing

  • Support design reviews and services integration with the construction program

  • Attend client, consultant and subcontractor meetings

  • Drive quality, safety and technical outcomes on site

About You

  • Degree in Building Services, Construction or Engineering or Electrical, Mechanical or Hydraulics 

  • 4–6 years’ experience in commercial construction

  • Experience with services coordination and finishing trades (builder or contractor)

  • Strong documentation, communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Stable employment history and a collaborative, solutions focused approach

Why Data Centres Are the Future

Data centres are one of the fastest growing and most secure sectors in construction. With demand driven by AI, cloud computing and digital infrastructure, they offer:

  • Future proof career pathways

  • Exposure to cutting edge building services and commissioning processes

  • Experience in a highly in demand and stable sector

  • Skills that transfer across health, defence, hyperscale and major infrastructure

This is the kind of project that moves your career forward, not sideways.

Why Join This Builder

This company is known for solving complex technical challenges through open communication and genuine teamwork. With a strong pipeline across data centres, health, commercial and education, they offer long term stability and real career progression.

What You’ll Gain

  • Mentorship from senior leaders in building services

  • Exposure to modern construction systems and mission critical environments

  • A culture built on trust, authenticity and long term relationships

  • Clear pathways into senior engineering, services management or project leadership

What’s On Offer

  • Competitive salary package

  • A key role on one of Australia’s benchmark data centre builds

  • Structured training, development and support within a high performing team

job.title: Senior Estimator
job.description:
Senior Estimator – Tier One International Builder | Data Centres & Hospitals

Step into a role with one of Australia’s award?winning MBA builders, a Tier One powerhouse quietly dominating the data centre and major health infrastructure space. This is the team behind $1B hyperscale facilities and $500M+ hospital redevelopments, a group whose Sydney division has become one of the city’s most consistent high performers. With a national reputation for quality, repeat clients across every sector, and a pipeline locked in well beyond 2027, this is where top estimators come to work on projects that actually move the needle.

This builder has grown steadily over the past 20 years and now employs more than 200 people nationally. Their Sydney branch is one of the quiet achievers of the construction market, delivering a diverse portfolio of projects exceeding $1B while maintaining exceptional relationships with clients and subcontractors. Their quality?driven approach has secured a strong repeat?business base across government, commercial, health, education and specialist sectors.

With a full order book and continued growth in the data centre and health markets, they are now seeking an experienced Estimator to join their high?performing pre?construction team.

Your Responsibilities

  • Break down drawings and specifications to detail all required materials, plant and equipment

  • Work closely with construction teams to forecast progress rates, programme impacts and cost implications

  • Prepare accurate cost estimates, incorporating overheads, risk allowances and profit margins

  • Develop and present tender submissions for major projects

  • Track, analyse and store cost data to continually improve pricing accuracy

  • Operate in a fast?paced tender environment where workload and deadlines fluctuate with market demand

This role is predominantly office?based and requires someone who thrives in a high?performance, deadline?driven environment.

What You Bring

  • Extensive estimating experience tendering for public sector or large?scale commercial/government projects

  • Proven ability to work under pressure and deliver to tight tender deadlines

  • A meticulous, detail?driven approach with strong analytical capability

  • A proactive, collaborative mindset — someone who works seamlessly with construction, design and commercial teams

  • Strong proficiency in MS Office and estimating platforms such as Buildsoft

  • Tertiary or trade background — both are welcome. What matters is your ability to deliver accurate, competitive tenders and support projects that finish on time, on budget and to a high standard.

Why This Group

You’ll be joining a builder known for:

  • MBA award?winning project delivery

  • Leadership in the data centre and health infrastructure sectors

  • Long?standing client relationships and a strong national reputation

  • A stable, supportive culture with genuine career longevity

  • A pipeline of major projects secured through 2027 and beyond

If you’re an experienced estimator looking to step into a role with scale, security and impact, apply now to learn more about this exceptional organisation.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Job Advertisement: Project Manager – National Bank Fitouts

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Project Manager to join a dynamic and growing team based in Alexandria. The role involves working closely with a team of four other project managers in a vibrant, young, and supportive environment, offering excellent work-life balance.

  • Liaise with key stakeholders and internal teams to ensure smooth communication and project delivery

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of quality and efficiency

  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company standards

  • Provide regular project updates to senior management

About You:

  • Proven experience in project management with a strong background in commercial fitouts, particularly within the banking sector

  • Demonstrated experience managing fitout projects valued up to $1M in New South Wales

  • Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and subcontractors

  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently

  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making skills

  • Local NSW experience essential

What We Offer:

  • A vibrant, collaborative work environment with a team-oriented culture

  • Monday to Friday work schedule (no weekends!)

  • Great work-life balance

  • Opportunity to lead exciting and impactful projects on a national scale

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level and be part of a great team, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now and join a workplace that values work-life balance, professional development, and a supportive culture.
